DECLARE

 place_except exception;

 v_def_thru_date date;
 Procedure save_form is
 begin
 :system.message_level:=10;
 post; -----commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0; 
 End save_form;

BEGIN
 hide_window('window1');

 IF :global.call_pos='C' then
 go_block('health_history_template');
 go_item('health_history_template.question_description'); -- Added by Kishore on 03/08/2010. SCR 16202
 hide_window('window1'); 
 do_key('clear_record');
 go_item('health_history_template.s_response'); -- Added by Kishore on 03/08/2010. SCR 16202

 ELSIF :global.call_pos='D' then
 v_incident_date:=to_date(:global.incident_date,'mm-dd-rrrr');
 v_def_thru_date:=to_date(:global.def_thru_date,'mm-dd-rrrr');

 remove_interdictions(:global.inter_code,:global.originated_from,:global.reason_code,
 v_incident_date,v_def_thru_date,null,:ctrl_blk_2.s_reason_code,
 v_status);

 go_block('health_history');
 hide_window('window1');

 if v_status!='OK' then
 raise remove_except;
 else
 go_block('health_history');
 hide_window('window1');
 delete_record;
 save_form;
 end if;
 
 ELSIF :global.call_pos='E' then
 remove_interdictions(:global.inter_code,:global.originated_from,:global.reason_code,
 null,null,null,:ctrl_blk_2.s_reason_code,v_status);

 if v_status !='OK' then
 :physical_findings.inter_code:=:global.inter_code;
 :physical_findings.physical_value:=:global.value;
 --:PHYSICAL_FINDINGS.comments:=:global.reason;
 go_item(:donation_interdictions.temp);
 hide_window('window1');
 raise remove_except;
 else
 save_form;
 go_item(:donation_interdictions.temp);
 hide_window('window1');
 end if;

 ELSIF :global.call_pos='B' then
 go_item('health_history.comments');
 execute_trigger('remove_place_inter');

 ELSIF :global.call_pos='F' then
 remove_interdictions(:global.inter_code,:global.originated_from,:global.reason_code,
 null,null,null,:ctrl_blk_2.s_reason_code,v_status);
 if v_status!='OK' then 
 raise remove_except;
 end if;

 place_interdictions(:physical_findings.inter_code,:physical_findings.physical_code,
 :physical_findings.physical_value,:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date,null,
 :physical_findings.comments,v_status);

 show_window('window0');
 if v_status!='OK' then 
 raise place_except;
 else
 save_form; 
 go_item(:donation_interdictions.temp);
 
 end if;
 
 END IF;
EXCEPTION 
 when remove_except then
 show_error('16112',v_status);
 check_package_failure;

 when place_except then
 show_error('16113',v_status);
 check_package_failure; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT);
 --
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --

 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN

 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION

PROCEDURE pop_reason (pl_physical_code IN VARCHAR2,pl_reason OUT VARCHAR2,pl_inter OUT VARCHAR2,pl_status out varchar2) IS
 -- MLT 1233 changes
 -- master codes table added to cursor to check for numeral_value flag.
 -- a value of 1 is a special case for TBV phy code where we need to check for equip type and age requirement 
 cursor cur_phy is
 select vpr.*
 from valid_physical_rules vpr, valid_master_codes vmc
 where vpr.physical_code = vmc.code
 and vmc.code_type = 'PHYCD'
 and vpr.physical_code = pl_physical_code
 and vpr.donation_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type
 and vpr.procedure_code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code
 and ( -- MLT 1233
 ( vmc.numeral_value = 1
 and global_var.n_donor_age between NVL(vpr.from_age,global_var.n_donor_age-1) and NVL(vpr.to_age, global_var.n_donor_age+1)
 and vpr.equip_type = global_var.equip_type
 )
 or
 (vmc.numeral_value <> 1)
 )
 and vpr.data_type in ('N', 'D') -- ='N' -- Modified for IM:9358/9359
 and vpr.gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) -- SCR 21483
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date_time between vpr.eff_date and nvl(vpr.term_date, sysdate + 1); -- SCR 18113

 v_rec valid_physical_rules%rowtype;
 v_reason varchar2(100);
 v_inter varchar2(5);
 v_max_val number;
 v_value number;
 v_data_type VARCHAR2(1);

BEGIN
 
 if cur_phy%isopen then
 close cur_phy;
 end if;


 open cur_phy;
 FETCH cur_phy into v_rec;
 
IF cur_phy%NOTFOUND then
 pl_status:='INVALID';
ELSE
 Begin 
 IF v_rec.data_type IN ('N', 'D') THEN -- ='N' then -- Modified for IM:9358/9359

 If v_rec.item_operator='BETWEEN' then 
 
 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);

 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) not between v_value and v_max_val then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code;
 v_reason:='Value should be in between '||v_rec.item_value||' - '||to_char(v_max_val);
 ---display_item('PHYSICAL_FINDINGS.comments','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;
 End if;

 If v_rec.item_operator='MORE' then

 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 

 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) > v_value then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code; 
 v_reason:='Value should be less than or equal to '||v_rec.item_value;
 --- display_item('PHYSICAL_FINDINGS.comments','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;

 End if;

 If v_rec.item_operator='LESS' then
 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 
 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) < v_value then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code; 
 v_reason:='Value should be greater than or equal to '||v_rec.item_value;
 ---display_item('PHYSICAL_FINDINGS.comments','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;
 End if;
 ELSE
 null; 
 END IF;
 Exception when value_error then
 null; 
 End; 


 pl_inter:=v_inter;
 pl_reason:=v_reason;
 pl_status:='OK';
END IF;

EXCEPTION when others
 then
 handle_error;
END;

PROCEDURE update_interdictions(pl_unit_id in varchar2, pl_donor_id in varchar2,pl_status out varchar2) IS

 health_history where transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id and program_id='NEW' and
 inter_code is not null;
 
 cursor phy_cur is select * from 
 physical_findings where transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id and inter_code is not null;

 Procedure place_inter_on_units( pl_origin in varchar2,pl_reason in varchar2 ,

 DON_INTER.PLACE_INTER_UNIT(pl_unit_id,null,:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date,

 pl_reason,null,pl_user,null,null,'DRUREAUD',null,null,v_routine_status);

BEGIN
 
 if donor_cur%isopen then

 select decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,3),'OPS',substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5),LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid) into v_user_id from dual;

 get_question_sequence(v_donor_rec.template_id,v_donor_rec.question_code,

 v_routine_status:=v_proc_status;

 raise v_routine_excpt;
 end if;

 place_inter_on_units(v_origin_from,v_donor_rec.answer_code,

 v_routine_status:=v_proc_status;

 raise v_routine_excpt;

PROCEDURE cal_days_deferred (pl_question_code in varchar2,pl_ans_code in varchar2,
 pl_inter_code out varchar2,pl_period_type out varchar2,
 pl_deferral_period out number,pl_no_of_days_defd out number,
 pl_def_status out varchar2) IS

cursor cur_ans is select * from valid_hh_answers where 
 question_code=pl_question_code and 
 answer_code=pl_ans_code and 
 response=:health_history_template.s_response and 
 sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);

v_rec valid_hh_answers%rowtype;
v_def_thru_days NUMBER;
v_period NUMBER;
v_period_type VARCHAR2(10);
v_inter_flag VARCHAR2(1);
out_exception EXCEPTION;
BEGIN

 if cur_ans%isopen then
 close cur_ans;
 end if;

 open cur_ans;
 FETCH cur_ans into v_rec;
 pl_inter_code:=v_rec.inter_code;
 pl_period_type:=v_rec.period_type;
 pl_deferral_period:=v_rec.deferral_period; 
 close cur_ans;

 if pl_inter_code is null and pl_deferral_period is null then /* not deferred*/
 raise OUT_EXCEPTION;
 end if;


 Begin
 if pl_period_type='P' then 
 pl_def_status:='P';
 raise OUT_EXCEPTION;
 end if;
 End;


 Begin
 If pl_inter_code is not null and /* Take def. period and type from the valid_interdictions if not in valid_hh_answers */
 pl_deferral_period is null and 
 pl_period_type is null then
 
 check_inter(pl_inter_code,v_period,v_period_type,v_inter_flag);
 if v_inter_flag='P' then 
 pl_def_status:='P'; 
 raise OUT_EXCEPTION;
 else 
 pl_deferral_period:=v_period;
 pl_period_type:=v_period_type;
 pl_def_status:='T'; 
 end if; 
 End if;
 End;
 
 if substr(pl_period_type,1,1)='D' then
 v_def_thru_days:=pl_deferral_period;
 elsif substr(pl_period_type,1,1)='W' then
 v_def_thru_days:=pl_deferral_period*7;
 elsif substr(pl_period_type,1,1)='M' then
 v_def_thru_days:=pl_deferral_period*30;
 elsif substr(pl_period_type,1,1)='Y' then
 v_def_thru_days:=pl_deferral_period*365;
 end if;

 pl_no_of_days_defd:=v_def_thru_days;


EXCEPTION when OUT_EXCEPTION then
 null;
END;
